import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
protected=[root/"lean-toolchain", root/"lakefile.toml", root/"lake-manifest.json", root/"LeanPML/Tutorial/LocalEnergy.lean", root/"ROADMAP_lean_PML_revised.md", Path.home()/".elan/settings.toml"]
protected += [p for p in (root/"docs").rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
protected += [p for p in (root/"logs/v0.0.3").rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
for project in [Path("/Users/wcli/Desktop/资料/graduate_student/博/Lean_study/ScalarDissipation"),root.parent/"lean_verification"]:
 protected += [project/n for n in ["lean-toolchain","lakefile.toml","lake-manifest.json"] if (project/n).is_file()]
snapshot={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in protected}
(root/"logs/v0.1.1/input_hashes.json").write_text(json.dumps(snapshot,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print("已记录",len(snapshot),"个受保护文件的初始 SHA-256。")
for n in ["README.md","PROGRESS.md","LeanPML.lean","Audit.lean"]:
 p=root/n
 dest=root/"logs/v0.1.1"/("before_"+n)
 dest.write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
 print("修改前快照:",dest.relative_to(root))
print("适用 AGENTS.md:")
found=[]
for d in list(root.parents)[::-1]+[root]:
 if (d/"AGENTS.md").is_file(): found.append(str(d/"AGENTS.md"))
for d in ["LeanPML","docs","scripts"]:
 found.extend(str(p) for p in (root/d).rglob("AGENTS.md"))
print(found)
print("固定工具链:",(root/"lean-toolchain").read_text().strip())
print("当前路线图哈希:",snapshot[str(root/"ROADMAP_lean_PML_revised.md")])
